title: 第23章 小师妹对他们还是仁善了
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
她又是哪里来的人物，“微生”，仙界有这么一号人物吗？

    “阿璃阿璃，角落那个男人在用神识探查你。”装逼系统提醒道。

    微生璃月的实力从一开始就没有隐瞒过，倒不怕他的探查。

    只是以她目前的身份，敢这般唐突试探自己，真以为她是泥人捏的？

    “统子，我要使用今日份的大乘期威压。”

    既然要装，那就得给这些人一点来自强者的震撼。

    只一瞬间，被天一散发出来的强者威压反噬后的赫连君翊猛然吐出一口鲜血，不可思议地看向微生璃月身边的侍女。

    她是大乘期。

    为什么如此低级的洲域会出现这样的强者，明明之前他感受到的气息只属于化神中期。

    突然之间修为暴涨，难不成是隐藏修为？

    若是在从前，别说是大乘，就连渡劫甚至是仙君赫连君翊都不放在眼里。

    可现在兵解转世后，修为十不存一，自己目前只有化神巅峰修为。

    若真要跟对方对上，只怕要燃烧神魂。

    在脑海中思索一番后，赫连君翊当即收回神识，往角落隐去。

    至于被大乘期威压突然强压跪了一地的众人：不是，刚刚发生了什么事，仙子怎么就突然生气了？

    因为站在微生璃月身后，免了跟众人一起跪地的林不语几人，暗暗松了口气。

    幸好他们跟小师妹是一个阵营的，要不然现在跪着的就是他们了。

    还有，天一大人竟然是大乘期！！！

    这可是他们太虚宗闭关老祖才拥有的实力，简直太可怕了。

    从元婴到化神，再到合体甚至大乘，小师妹身边的天一大人不会一直都在隐藏实力吧？

    越想越觉得这是事实，几人默默给小师妹的危险指数再次提升了几个等级。

    忽然收到谢长泽和陆明薇几人提供的装逼值，微生璃月有点懵，他们几个又脑补了些什么？

    没时间去探究自己这几个师兄师姐的想法，微生璃月将视线放到角落那抹紫色身影上，眼神中流露出不屑：“一介蝼蚁，竟也妄想窥探神明，再有下次，格杀……勿论！”
content_en:
Where did she come from, "Weisheng", is there such a number one person in the fairy world?

"Ali Ali, the man in the corner is using his spiritual consciousness to detect you." The pretentious system reminded.

Weisheng Liyue's strength has not been concealed from the beginning, so she is not afraid of his detection.

But with her current status, she dared to test herself so abruptly. Do you really think she was made by a clay figurine?

"Tongzi, I want to use today's Mahayana pressure."

Since you want to pretend, you have to give these people a little shock from the strong.

In just a moment, Helian Junyi, who was counterattacked by the powerful pressure emanating from Tianyi, suddenly spat out a mouthful of blood and looked at the maid next to Wei Sheng Liyue in disbelief.

She is in the Mahayana stage.

Why would such a strong person appear in such a low-level continent? The aura he felt before clearly only belonged to the middle stage of divine transformation.

My cultivation level suddenly skyrocketed. Could it be that I was hiding my cultivation level?

In the past, not to mention the Mahayana, even the Tribulation Tribulation and even the Immortal Lord Helian Junyi would not take it seriously.

But now, after Bingjie's reincarnation, his cultivation level is out of ten, and he currently only has the peak cultivation level of God Transformation.

If he really wanted to confront the opponent, he would probably burn his soul.

After thinking about it in his mind, Helian Junyi immediately withdrew his consciousness and hid in the corner.

As for the people who were suddenly forced to kneel on the ground by the pressure of the Mahayana period: No, what happened just now? Why did the fairy suddenly become angry?

Because they were standing behind Weisheng Liyue, Lin Buyu and the others, who did not have to kneel with everyone else, secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

Fortunately, they are in the same camp as the junior sister, otherwise they would be the ones kneeling now.

Also, Lord Tianyi is actually in the Mahayana stage!!!

This is the strength that only their Taixu Sect secluded ancestor possesses, and it is simply terrifying.

From the Nascent Soul to the God Transformation, to the Fusion and even the Mahayana, Master Tianyi beside the little junior sister is not hiding his strength all the time, right?

The more I thought about it, the more I felt that this was true, and several people silently raised the risk index for the junior sister by several levels.

Suddenly receiving pretentious points from Xie Changze and Lu Mingwei, Weisheng Liyue was a little confused. What were they thinking?

Not having time to explore the thoughts of his senior brothers and sisters, Weisheng Liyue focused his attention on the purple figure in the corner, with disdain in his eyes: "An ant actually wants to spy on the gods. If he does it next time, I will kill him... no matter what!"
title_en: Chapter 23 The junior sister is still kind to them
